description: Reads staged callback bindings, observed verification signals and the active or paused installation state for the connected site. Read-only. A verified callback proves receipt only, not business success or permission to send live. A matching pending approve-and-start request activates automatically after every fresh current-key check; otherwise the signed-in owner activates separately. Agents cannot activate manually. Active authorization does not prove live client deployment or Meta receipt.
name: read_conversion_installation
title: Read installation state
